micro_markets.name: Thane West
micro_markets.usp: Mumbai's fastest-growing suburb — Metro Line 4 operational Dec 2025, bullet train hub 2028. 40% cheaper than Mumbai island city.
micro_markets.target_buyer: Mumbai working professionals, families seeking larger homes, NRI investors
micro_markets.infrastructure: Metro Line 4 & 4A (58km, 21 lakh daily ridership), Bullet train station, Eastern Express Highway, Ghodbunder Road
micro_markets.pros: Best connectivity upgrade in MMR, affordable vs Mumbai, excellent social infrastructure
micro_markets.cons: Growing traffic, some areas still congested, monsoon waterlogging in pockets

micro_markets.name: Thane — Ghodbunder Road
micro_markets.usp: Entry-level Thane — best value in MMR. Godrej, Hiranandani, Lodha all present. Direct Mumbai-Nashik highway.
micro_markets.target_buyer: First-time buyers, young couples, investors seeking rental income
micro_markets.infrastructure: Ghodbunder Road widening, Metro Line 5 (Thane-Bhiwandi-Kalyan), proposed tunnel to Borivali
micro_markets.pros: Lowest entry in Thane, multiple builder options, strong rental demand
micro_markets.cons: Heavy traffic, distance from station, ongoing construction noise

micro_markets.name: Zirakpur — VIP Road / Airport Road
micro_markets.usp: Chandigarh's most affordable entry point. 10 min to Chandigarh, 15 min to airport. Punjab NRI favorite.
micro_markets.target_buyer: Punjab NRIs (Dubai/Canada/UK), Chandigarh working professionals, first-time buyers
micro_markets.infrastructure: PR-7 Airport Road, Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, approved metro corridor, 15 min to airport
micro_markets.pros: Lowest entry in Tricity, NRI demand strong, metro approved, Chandigarh proximity
micro_markets.cons: Some pockets oversupplied, infrastructure catching up, VIP Road traffic

micro_markets.name: Mohali — Aerocity / Sector 66-85
micro_markets.usp: IT City Mohali — Quark, IDS Infotech, tech parks driving employment. GMADA planned sectors.
micro_markets.infrastructure: IT City, International Airport 10 min, GMADA sectors, metro extension planned
micro_markets.pros: Planned development, IT employment, airport proximity
micro_markets.cons: Slower than Zirakpur, some sectors underdeveloped

micro_markets.name: New Chandigarh (Mullanpur)
micro_markets.usp: GMADA's planned extension of Chandigarh — medicity, sports zones, education hubs. DLF's ultra-luxury Hyde Park Estate.
micro_markets.infrastructure: Chandigarh-Manali Highway, proposed metro, PGI Hospital proximity, medicity planned
micro_markets.pros: Planned development, Chandigarh extension, luxury segment available
micro_markets.cons: Early stage, limited current infrastructure, long-term play

key_drivers: Metro Line 4 & 4A — 58km, India's longest elevated metro, 21 lakh daily ridership
Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train — Thane station, 320 km/hr, 2028 operational
Borivali-Thane Tunnel — 15 min travel time, under construction
MTHL (Atal Setu) — Mumbai-Navi Mumbai 20 min, already operational

chandigarh_tricity.trend: Bullish — Metro approved, NRI demand surge, limited Chandigarh land supply
key_drivers: Chandigarh Metro — Approved, 2025-26 completion expected for Phase 1
IT Park expansion — Mohali IT City Phase 2, 50,000+ additional jobs
Airport expansion — International flights increasing, cargo hub planned
NRI remittance — Punjab-origin NRIs from Dubai/Canada/UK driving demand
Limited Chandigarh supply — Sectors 1-56 fully developed, no new land
PR-7 Airport Road widening — Zirakpur connectivity improving
chandigarh_tricity.price_forecast_3yr: Zirakpur 20-25%, Mohali 15-18%, New Chandigarh 25-30% (from low base)

interest_rates.trend: Stable — good time to lock in rates
interest_rates.quote_to_callers_mumbai: Sir, home loan rate abhi 8.4-8.5% chal raha hai. SBI aur HDFC best offers de rahe hain. Aapka salary ₹X+ hai toh ₹Y crore tak ka loan easily sanction ho jayega. Pre-approval letter nikalwa deta hoon — builder ko dikhake negotiation mein fayda hoga.

competitors.name: Lodha Group
competitors.positioning: India's largest real estate developer by sales volume. Premium to ultra-luxury focus.
competitors.price_position: Premium — 20-30% above market average in Thane
competitors.our_positioning: Lodha ke saath hamara corporate tie-up hai. Through VK Realty book karenge toh corporate discount + priority allotment milta hai. Same Lodha project, better price.
competitors.sample_script_hinglish: Lodha Amara sirf naam hi kaafi hai sir. 40 acres, 70% open space, 6 swimming pools. ₹85 lakh se 1BHK start. Hamare through book karenge toh corporate discount milega — recent client ne ₹1.42 Cr ke jagah ₹1.38 Cr mein 2BHK liya.

competitors.name: L&T Realty
competitors.positioning: Engineering-led developer, quality construction, trust factor from parent L&T
competitors.our_positioning: L&T ka quality best hai sir. Engineer background se construction mein koi compromise nahi. Hamare paas unke Thane projects mein exclusive inventory hai.
competitors.sample_script_hinglish: L&T Evara Heights Pokhran Road pe hai sir — ₹1.70 Cr se 2BHK. L&T ka naam matlab trust. 12 acres, 56 floors ki towers. Hamare clients ko floor rise charges mein discount milta hai.

competitors.name: Piramal Realty
competitors.positioning: Design-focused luxury developer, attention to detail, smaller boutique projects
competitors.our_positioning: Piramal design aur quality mein top hai. 32-acre Vaikunth Balkum mein — dual aspect apartments, 3.2m floor height. Hamare NRI clients bahut pasand karte hain.
competitors.sample_script_hinglish: Piramal Vaikunth 32 acres pe hai sir, Balkum mein. Dual aspect apartments — do taraf khidkiyaan, ventilation best hai. ₹1.1 Cr se start. NRI clients ke liye perfect hai kyunki design international standard ka hai.

competitors.name: Sushma Buildtech
competitors.positioning: Chandigarh Tricity's most trusted local developer — Zirakpur/Mohali specialists
competitors.our_positioning: Zirakpur mein Sushma ka naam sabse zyada trusted hai. 15+ saal se market mein hain. Hamare paas unka VIP Road pe exclusive inventory hai — direct builder rates se 2-3% kam.
competitors.sample_script_punjabi: Sushma Zirakpur da sab ton vadiya builder aa sir. 15 saal ton kaam kar rahe ne. Belleza VIP Road te — 3BHK ₹1.35 Cr to. Hamare through book karoge taan PLC charges mein discount milega.

competitors.name: DLF Limited
competitors.positioning: India's largest listed developer. Ultra-luxury and plotted development specialists.
competitors.our_positioning: DLF luxury segment ka baap hai sir. New Chandigarh mein Hyde Park Estate — villas ₹5 Cr se upar. HNI aur NRI clients ke liye best. Hamare paise direct DLF se connection hai.
competitors.sample_script_hinglish: DLF Hyde Park Estate New Chandigarh mein hai sir — ₹5 Cr se villas start. India's largest listed developer hai. NRI clients Dubai se specifically DLF maangte hain. Hamara unka direct channel hai.

objection_scripts.price_too_high_mumbai: Sir, Thane Mumbai se 40% sasta hai. Same configuration Mumbai mein ₹3 Cr+ jaata hai, yahan ₹1.5-2 Cr mein milta hai. Metro aa gaya hai, bullet train aa raha hai — 2 saal mein yeh price ₹2.5 Cr+ hoga. EMI compare kariye rent se.
objection_scripts.price_too_high_chandigarh: Sir, Zirakpur Chandigarh se 50% sasta hai. Same area Chandigarh mein ₹8,000-12,000/sq ft hai, Zirakpur mein ₹5,000-6,800. Metro approve ho gayi hai, completion ke baad aur jump aayega. Lock kariye abhi.
objection_scripts.not_ready_to_move: Samajhta hoon sir. Lekin under-construction mein 10-15% discount milta hai. Plus payment CLP mein jaata hai — burden kam. Thane mein kuch ready options bhi hain lekin 15% premium hai. Sochiye kya priority hai — immediate ya savings.
objection_scripts.will_wait: Sir, 2023 se Thane mein 15-20% appreciation ho chuka hai. Metro operational ho gaya hai, abhi bhi entry achha hai. Wait karne ka matlab same budget mein chhota ghar ya door location. Abhi lock kariye — rate guarantee hai.
objection_scripts.other_builder_cheaper: Haan sir, ₹200-300/sq ft ka difference normal hai. Lekin RERA check kariye — cheaper builder ka delay history kaisa hai? 1 saal delay hua toh rent + EMI dono dena padta hai. Hamare builders sab verified, on-time delivery track record.
objection_scripts.need_family_discussion: Bilkul sir, parivar se baat karna zaroori hai. Main aapko 48 hours hold karwa deta hoon — koi token nahi, koi commitment nahi. Floor preference aur unit bhi block ho jayegi. Kal tak decision le lijiye.
